table.name: watchtower_health_state
table.comment: Durable state for the cron_health signal.

column.name: event_type
column.comment: Tracked signal event type, e.g. cron_health

column.name: pending_status
column.comment: Raw status awaiting a second consecutive confirmation

column.name: sequence_number
column.comment: Next sequence number for this event type

table.name: watchtower_report_buffer
table.comment: Reports that failed to submit, queued for retry.

column.name: event_type
column.comment: Tracked signal event type, e.g. cron_health

column.name: status
column.comment: SignalStatus value when this report was produced

column.name: sequence_number
column.comment: Sequence number assigned at evaluation, fixed on retry

column.name: evaluated_at
column.comment: Original evaluation instant, in UTC, fixed on retry

column.name: reason
column.comment: ReportReason value when this report was produced

column.name: ruleset_version
column.comment: Ruleset version in effect when produced

column.name: created_at
column.comment: When this report was first buffered

table.name: watchtower_submission_backoff
table.comment: Shared retry backoff clock, plus the last successful submission time.

column.name: last_success_at
column.comment: When a submission last succeeded, for the diagnostics page/watchtower:status

table.name: watchtower_organization_state
table.comment: Locally cached organization_paused flag, singleton row.

table.name: watchtower_submission_outcome_log
table.comment: Last N submission outcomes, self-pruned to newest N on every write.

column.name: rejected_count
column.comment: Reports the platform rejected (still counted as a successful HTTP round-trip)

column.name: rejection_reasons
column.comment: JSON object of reason string to count, for the rejected reports in this attempt

table.name: watchtower_rollup_hourly
table.comment: Per store view/category hourly counts, retained ~90 days.

column.name: category
column.comment: Signal name, e.g. basket_quote, checkout, customer_account

column.name: hour_bucket
column.comment: UTC top-of-hour instant this row counts

column.name: count
column.comment: Event count observed in this hour

table.name: watchtower_rollup_daily
table.comment: Per store view/category daily counts, retained 400+ days.

column.name: category
column.comment: Signal name, e.g. basket_quote, checkout, customer_account

column.name: day_bucket
column.comment: UTC calendar day this row counts

column.name: count
column.comment: Event count summed from that day's hourly rows

table.name: watchtower_event_counter
table.comment: Per store view event-bus counters, e.g. customer_login and customer_logout.

column.name: hour_bucket
column.comment: UTC top-of-hour instant this row counts

column.name: count
column.comment: Event count observed in this hour

table.name: watchtower_dispersion_state
table.comment: Durable debounce state for Check A, per store view and category.

column.name: category
column.comment: Signal category, e.g. basket_quote, checkout, customer_account

column.name: pending_status
column.comment: Raw status awaiting a second consecutive confirmation

column.name: sequence_number
column.comment: Next sequence number for this store view and category

table.name: watchtower_event_drop_counter
table.comment: Local diagnostic count of events with no resolvable store, never transmitted.

column.name: hour_bucket
column.comment: UTC top-of-hour instant this row counts

column.name: count
column.comment: Dropped event count observed in this hour

table.name: watchtower_integration_health_config
table.comment: Per-store-view configured integration_health source (admin source picker).

column.name: source_identifier
column.comment: A job_code, topic_name, or integration label, depending on source_type

column.name: expected_max_interval_minutes
column.comment: How long a success may go unrenewed before this store view reports DOWN

table.name: watchtower_integration_health_event
table.comment: Local snapshot of watchtower_integration_health event dispatches (source #3).

column.name: store_view_id
column.comment: Magento store view id this dispatch is attributed to

column.name: integration_label
column.comment: The integration label the dispatching module supplied

table.name: watchtower_integration_health_state
table.comment: Durable debounce state for integration_health, per store view.

column.name: pending_status
column.comment: Raw status awaiting a second consecutive confirmation

column.name: sequence_number
column.comment: Next sequence number for this store view

table.name: watchtower_environment_state
table.comment: Environment facts and the platform-supplied EOL determination from the last sync, singleton row.

column.name: magento_version
column.comment: This install's Magento version as of the last sync, e.g. 2.4.9

column.name: magento_edition
column.comment: This install's Magento edition as of the last sync, e.g. Community

column.name: connector_version
column.comment: This connector's own installed version as of the last sync

column.name: magento_is_eol
column.comment: Platform's EOL determination for magento_version/magento_edition; null means undetermined

column.name: synced_at
column.comment: When this state was last refreshed

table.name: watchtower_connector_version_state
table.comment: Last successful GET connector-version check outcome, singleton row.

column.name: installed_version
column.comment: This connector's own version as of the last successful check

column.name: minimum_version
column.comment: Platform-configured floor as of the last successful check

column.name: latest_version
column.comment: Platform-configured latest as of the last successful check

column.name: below_minimum
column.comment: Whether submission is currently self-disabled for being below minimum_version

column.name: update_available
column.comment: Non-blocking: installed_version is below latest_version but at/above minimum_version

table.name: watchtower_ignored_domain_state
table.comment: Last sync's ignored-local-domain outcome (PRD FR28-30), singleton row.

column.name: ignored_count
column.comment: Store views the last sync rejected with reason_code ignored_local_domain

column.name: example_code
column.comment: One rejected store view's code from the last sync, null when ignored_count is 0

table.name: watchtower_report_cycle_state
table.comment: When Cron\ReportJob's real evaluate-and-submit cycle last ran, singleton row.

column.name: last_run_at
column.comment: When the real cycle last ran; null if it never has
